20|21 Interior
The look and feel of luxury.
From thoughtful conveniences, such as side-door pockets that are
wide enough to hold water bottles, to numerous luxurious touches,
the X3's spacious interior is designed to make you feel welcome.
Even the grain of the leather-covered dash is fine and supple. The
trim package is available in three stunning, genuine wood grain options.
An auxiliary input on the center console comes standard and lets you
run your MP3 player through the X3's SIRIUS Satellite Radio sound
system. HD Radio™ receives free, digital broadcasts with CD-quality
sound, ª multicastº FM stations, and innovative data services. Inside
and out, every inch of the X3 is a showcase of BMW quality.
Shown with Sport Package interior.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the
Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the back of this brochure.

--- page 12 ---
Interior 22|23
The battle for the front passenger seat
is offi cially over.
Unlike other vehicles in its class, the X3 is one thrill ride with space
for everybody. The rear seating area amply accommodates up to
three adults, giving your passengers a leg up on legroom. A folding
center back-seat console allows two passengers to enjoy a typical
ª front-seatº amenity. The comfortable seating design and trim add to
the elegance. And with the heated rear seats ± a rare luxury ± available
as part of the X3's Cold Weather Package, back-seat passengers stay
cozy and warm.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the
Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the back of this brochure.

--- page 13 ---
Interior 24|25
Plenty of room for all that matters.
A spacious and functional cabin is a hallmark of the X3. From the front-seat cupholders to the
60/40 split-folding rear seats to the bicycle rack accessory that easily stows two bikes, the X3
is designed to let you pack more of your life into your BMW safely and quickly. Roof rails make
topside hauling a breeze, while the interior boasts plenty of room for groceries, sports equipment
and more. The interior rails, luggage nets and reversible non-slip floor help keep your cargo
secure on any trip. Which is good news, since you're going to want to keep on driving the
X3 mile after mile ± to work, on vacation, and whenever the need for fun moves you.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the
back of this brochure.
